metrics.description: Recall@10 for title and body snippet queries on canonical notes
metrics.justification: Agents must find relevant canonical memories when querying with explicit terminology.
metrics.retrieval_impact: Low recall causes agents to hallucinate or miss stored procedures and facts.

metrics.description: MRR (Mean Reciprocal Rank) on known-item queries
metrics.justification: Canonical target note should rank as close to rank 1 as possible.
metrics.retrieval_impact: Low MRR forces agents to process unnecessary context tokens from lower-ranked items.

metrics.description: Semantic recall under linguistic variation and reformulation
metrics.justification: Conversational queries rarely match exact note titles verbatim.
metrics.retrieval_impact: Vocabulary mismatch degrades lexical recall without semantic or associative support.
metrics.target_threshold: Recall@10 >= 0.60, MRR >= 0.40 (or WARN if LLM offline)

metrics.description: Graph Rescue Rate (cases where direct search missed but graph expansion succeeded)
metrics.justification: Graph expansion must rescue relevant notes disconnected from surface query keywords.
metrics.retrieval_impact: Low rescue rate indicates graph expansion adds latency without discovering new answers.

metrics.description: Net Gain (rescued relevant items minus false positive expansions)
metrics.justification: Expansion must produce more rescued relevant items than irrelevant clutter.
metrics.retrieval_impact: Negative net gain floods council context window with noise.

metrics.description: Multi-hop recall over shared technical entity / tag bridges
metrics.justification: Cross-domain knowledge items often connect via shared architectural entities.
metrics.retrieval_impact: Failure to follow entity bridges leaves associated components isolated.

metrics.description: Strict compliance with ACTIVE + verified ceiling (0 leaks allowed)
metrics.justification: Invariants I-001..I-012 prohibit unverified or in-review notes from entering council runtime.
metrics.retrieval_impact: Security leak allows untrusted external imports or prompt injections into agent context.

metrics.description: 100% identical ranking and score parity across repeated queries
metrics.justification: Reproducibility is essential for cognitive debugging, test suites, and audit logs.
metrics.retrieval_impact: Non-deterministic results produce flaky agent decisions and unreproducible failures.

metrics.justification: Context assembly runs in the critical cognitive path before council agent execution.
metrics.retrieval_impact: High latency slows multi-agent turn cycles and creates UI sluggishness.
